en.headline: Hong Kong Watch and Clock Fair opens at the Convention Centre
en.dek: The Trade Development Council's 45th edition runs through Saturday at the Wan Chai venue, alongside Salon de TIME, and is open to trade visitors aged 18 or above.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council's Watch and Clock Fair opened today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai and runs until Saturday. The council describes this as the fair's 45th edition, covering complete watches and clocks, parts and components, machinery, packaging and wearable technology.

The physical fair is open from 10am to 6.30pm from 1 to 4 September and from 10am to 5.30pm on 5 September. Buyer registration starts at 9.30am. Admission is limited to trade visitors aged 18 or above. The venue is at 1 Expo Drive, reached through the Harbour Road entrance.

Salon de TIME, a concurrent luxury-watch showcase, is also listed at the same complex from 1 to 5 September. The council's programme for opening day includes the Hong Kong International Watch Forum at 2.30pm in meeting rooms S226-227, with industry representatives from the mainland, Germany, France, Switzerland, Japan and South Korea.

Last year's combined Watch and Clock Fair and Salon de TIME figures published by the council listed 652 exhibitors from 13 countries and regions and 15,787 on-site buyers. An online matching service runs separately until 12 September. Visitors should complete the organiser's registration before travelling.

zh.headline: 香港鐘表展今起於灣仔會展開鑾
zh.dek: 貿發局第四十五屆鐘表展舉行至周六，同期有國際名表蕃萃，實體展只開放予十八歲或以上業內人士。
body: 香港貿易發展局主辦的香港鐘表展今日於灣仔香港會議展覽中心揭幕，展期至周六。貿發局指今屆為第四十五屆，展出整錶、鐘、配件零件、機械設備、包裝及可穿戴科技。
實體展九月一日至四日上午十時至下午六時三十分開放，五日上午十時至下午五時三十分，買家登記上午九時三十分開始。入場限十八歲或以上業內人士。場地為博覽道一號會展，經港灣道入口。
同期舉行的國際名表蕃萃亦於同場九月一日至五日舉行。開幕當日下午二時半於S226-227會議室舉辦香港國際鐘表論壇，講者包括內地、德國、法國、瑞士、日本及韓國業界代表。
貿發局公布去年鐘表展與名表蕃萃合計有六百五十二家參展商，來自十三個國家及地區，實體買家一萬五千七百八十七人。線上配對平台另行運作至九月十二日。參觀人士出發前須按主辦單位安排完成登記。
